messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "may need to stop use before surgery, medical procedure, or dental work"
set: ["may need to stop use before surgery, medical procedure, or dental work", "may need to stop use before imaging tests", "may need to stop for short time before planned surgery or dental procedure", "may need to temporarily stop taking", "may need to stop for short time if have surgery or medical emergency", "may also need to shake your albuterol device just before each use", "may need to prime your albuterol inhaler device before the first use", "kidney function may need to be checked before taking", "if used long-term, may need frequent medical tests", "may need a lower dose or need to stop taking the medicine for a short period or for good", "first dose usually taken before surgery, chemotherapy, or radiation treatment", "you may need to stop using the medicine for a short time", "before first use", "dose may need adjusting", "doctor may need to adjust dose accordingly", "doctor may need to adjust diabetes medications"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
